bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to state government; precluding naming laws after people; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 10.49.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 10.49, is amended to read:

10.49 NAMING.
Laws enacted on or after July 1, [-2009-][+ 2025+], must not be named for [-living-] people, and laws may not name councils, buildings, roads, or other facilities or entities after living people.

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
